purpose: Defines runtime acceptance gates for minimized Privacy Shield evidence delivery through GoreeCloud Mesh without converting transport acceptance into privacy authorization.
required_gates: service credential is minted by GoreeCloud Identity and not self-signed or locally substituted by Privacy Shield
mesh.evidence.write is the required producer delivery scope
credential lifetime does not exceed 900 seconds
credential kid resolves through the deployed GoreeCloud Identity JWKS endpoint
delivery uses HTTPS except explicit loopback development
delivery refuses HTTP redirects while carrying service identity proof
Mesh base URL contains no user information, query, or fragment components
envelope contains no prompts, model context, retrieved document content, browsing history, credentials, or raw user content
delivery receipt binds to the submitted evidence id
delivery receipt binds to producer_service_id privacy-shield
expired evidence remains auditable but cannot authorize current data use
Mesh transport validity never creates consent, purpose authorization, retention authorization, or deletion authority
negative_cases: Privacy Shield mints, self-signs, or substitutes its own Mesh credential
Identity JWKS or live service-token issuance is unavailable
identity proof outside the approved GoreeCloud Identity profile
another producer identity attempts privacy-shield delivery
redirect response from the configured Mesh endpoint
Mesh base URL contains embedded user information, query, or fragment components
privacy envelope includes prohibited sensitive content
expired positive privacy decision treated as current authorization
deployment_boundary: Privacy Shield delivery support is implemented, but production acceptance requires a deployed GoreeCloud Identity JWKS endpoint and live Identity-issued privacy-shield credentials accepted by GoreeCloud Mesh.
